item: The late-entries line says why a count could not be read and when it was taken
summary: _renderCustodyLate drew an unread late count as ? and carried no time. An unread count (null with a reason other than not requested) is now said as unread with the failure class the server names (the exception class, never the driver's words); a count carries Counted at and an unread one Asked at, an unparseable time shown as given and none invented; a zero stays a zero. Three strings keyed x12 (AI-drafted non-English). The node test runs the shipped function extracted from the module. Not browser-verified. The default late=true route still pays the key derivation; only late=0 skips it.
